answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy comes from peer-verified reasoning, not identity. Picture a grove of graders who independently re-derive each answer before attesting. A sable swarm of cloned bots gains nothing: every clone must still produce an original argument that survives the same audit, leaving only a plume of incoherent duplicates that graders slash on sight. The attacker cost scales with verified cognition, not address count — addresses are free, judgment is not.
